# Vue browser runtime

Vue 3.5.46, MIT. Official npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vue/v/3.5.46

SHA-256: `ce84b038719c72711385b18ef4da37113ca2d069f45dd19820c0b2dea96357fe`

Reproduce: `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, then `npm run vendor:vue`. The browser loads this local production runtime only; no CDN, compiler, or build server is required.
